NDT ERP for Billings: three refineries and a service territory measured in hundreds of miles

An NDT ERP for Billings has to handle two things at once: three refineries within a short drive of downtown, and field jobs spread across Montana, Wyoming and North Dakota. The software must keep technicians certified and equipment calibrated for demanding refinery clients, and it must also cost and bill travel, standby and per diems properly on jobs several hours away.

Yellowstone County has three refineries: Phillips 66 in Billings, Par Pacific's Billings refinery in Lockwood (which Par Pacific took over from ExxonMobil in June 2023, with about 62,000 barrels a day of capacity), and the CHS refinery in Laurel. Each processes roughly 60,000 barrels a day, and together they pay a large share of the county's property taxes. Beyond them, a Billings contractor's week can include pipeline and gas-plant work in the Bakken and the Powder River Basin, power generation work, and fabrication-shop inspection in town. That combination of concentrated refinery work and very long drives is what shapes the software requirements here.

The Atlantis ERP solution is a fully customized ERP for NDT and inspection companies, set up and supported by Atlantis NDT (founder Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III). It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable. Book a Billings demo.

What is the best NDT inspection software for a company covering Montana and the northern Rockies?

The best NDT inspection software for a Billings company works offline in the field, records travel and standby accurately, and keeps certificate and calibration evidence ready for refinery gatekeepers. The Atlantis ERP brings offline reporting, timesheets with work types, fleet records and certificate tracking into one system.

Distance changes the economics. A two-hour UT thickness job at a compressor station might need four or five hours of driving each way, a night in a motel and a meal allowance. If those hours and expenses are not captured against the job, the job loses money while looking profitable on paper. In the Atlantis ERP, timesheets record work type as inspection, travel, standby or setup, along with method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, and go through approval. Field expenses and per diems are recorded in the expenses app and re-billed to jobs.

Connectivity is the second issue. Much of eastern Montana and the neighbouring basins has patchy coverage. The offline field app, an installable web app, works without signal, stores drafts and photos locally and syncs later, with method picker, photo capture, on-screen signature and PDF preview, so reports are written at the location rather than reconstructed that night. See timesheets and expenses.

Technician certification tracking software for refinery pre-qualification

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP records every certificate by scheme, level, method, certifying body, sector and dates, and computes its status automatically: active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked. Supported schemes include SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and others.

Three refineries in one county means three contractor-management systems, each asking for evidence of qualification before a technician gets a badge. Holding each technician's certificates, OJT hours, training hours, exam results and attachments in one record means the office can respond to each refinery's request quickly and consistently. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test and exam are required, and minimum OJT and training hours.

Vision tests are tracked with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception and contrast, examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry. Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a passing score of 70 percent by default. The employee NDT profile shows highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry.

Warning tasks are created 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires. Daily email alerts cover technician certificates, calibration certificates and company certifications, with recipients, look-ahead days and resend interval set by you. That is useful in a small market where one or two lapsed certificates can leave you short on a method when a refinery calls. Timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. See certificates.

Calibration management software for equipment that spends its life on the road

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP holds full calibration records (provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result, next due date) and a calibration certificate register with the lab's accreditation number, the PDF, status and expiry alerts.

Billings is a long way from most calibration labs, so instruments spend real time in transit. Knowing a gauge's due date early enough to ship it and still have it back before a refinery job is the difference between planning and scrambling. Each item is tracked by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status, including in calibration, in repair and rented out, so you can see at a glance what is actually available. Purchasing flags vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab and links purchase order lines to a specific equipment serial.

Equipment spends days in trucks through Montana winters and summers. The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, repairs, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacement, with condition before and after. Issue and return goes through supervisor and manager approval and records condition at both ends. Reservations prevent clashes, and team assignments warn when assigned equipment is out of calibration. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, MT particles and PPE are tracked with reorder levels and a low-stock flag, which matters when the nearest supplier is not next door. See asset management.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for long-distance mobilisation

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP runs jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serials, and records site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. For a company sending crews hundreds of miles, mobilisation dates are as important as the job dates.

The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps. The dispatcher sees each technician's status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date in calendar, kanban or list view. When a refinery in Laurel wants a crew on Monday and a pipeline job near Williston runs a day long, the dispatcher can see immediately who is free, who is still on the road and which instruments are coming back.

The fleet app records vehicle purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and its assignment to a project and driver with dates and mileage. Mileage by project gives you real travel cost per job, which feeds your next quote. Projects record job type, site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, and safety induction and work permit fields, so a crew driving five hours does not arrive without the required induction. See team assignments and fleet.

NDT reporting software for refinery, pipeline and shop work

The Atlantis ERP supports 17 report types with separate numbering: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday and coating, and computed radiography. Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures.

A Billings company's mix is broad. Refinery work covers UT thickness readings by direction, ECT and IRIS on exchanger bundles, MFL on tank floors, and PMI, hardness and PWHT on repairs. Pipeline and gas-plant work leans on RT or computed radiography and PAUT for welds, and holiday testing on coatings. Fabrication shops need VT, MT and UT on structural and pressure welds. Method-specific fields are built in: UT probe calibration table, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, and PAUT focal laws. Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation, and each report records work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references.

Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your logo, header and footer, and Excel templates are filled automatically by mapping fields to cells, which helps with each refinery's own data sheets. A third-party or authorised inspector's name and signature can be captured. A REST API for field devices handles jobs assigned to the technician, equipment issued, report submission and sync. See NDT reports and Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Procedure control for a small Level III team

The procedure register records document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard (such as ASME Section V), acceptance criteria and body text or an uploaded file. The workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejection and archiving, and approved revisions are locked with a full revision history.

Many Billings companies have one Level III, sometimes on contract, who is responsible for every procedure and often in the field. Email notifications and reminders to approvers mean pending procedures do not wait until that person is back in the office. The AI-assisted first draft, which falls back to a built-in template, gives the Level III a starting point for a new procedure that a refinery or pipeline operator has asked for; the Level III still reviews and approves it.

Every revision is kept as a snapshot with who prepared, reviewed and approved it and when, so an audit question about which revision applied to a job two years ago can be answered directly. Methods include UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more. See procedures and, for outside help, Level III consulting.

NDT quoting and invoicing software that captures the drive

Quotes in the Atlantis ERP record job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, built from NDT service products flagged with method and category, with an optional global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance and signature that converts the quote to a sales order. Remote jobs should be quoted with travel and per diem lines that reflect what they really cost; the fleet mileage and timesheet history from past jobs gives you that figure.

Invoices carry the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables. Lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Travel and standby hours come in from approved timesheets with their billable flag and rate multiplier; expenses and per diems are re-billed to jobs. Taxes and payment terms are configured for Montana and any other states you invoice in during implementation.

The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over twelve months. Using cost centres, a Billings owner can compare refinery work in town with remote pipeline work and see which one is really carrying the business. Ask how we would set up travel and per diem billing.

Affordable, cloud NDT software for small inspection companies in Billings

Most inspection companies in Billings are small or mid-size, and many compete with larger national contractors for refinery work. An affordable ERP helps them look organised to refinery quality departments without adding office staff. The Atlantis ERP runs in a browser and on a phone, includes the business apps, and is quoted on request.

Implementation usually starts with certificates and calibration, then moves to projects, dispatch and timesheets, and then to reporting and invoicing. Items that are not built in are configured during implementation. Dashboards show certificates expiring or expired, calibration due or overdue and issued equipment overdue for return. The CRM records service line, NDT service type, industry sector, site and estimated technicians and days, scores leads from 0 to 100, and can run drip email sequences, while the business card app turns a photographed card into a lead.

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. For 3D visualisation of inspection data, with indication mapping and thickness trends, see Atlantis Digital Twins. Training from Atlantis NDT is ASNT SNT-TC-1A based; see training and the Practical NDT simulator.

Frequently asked questions

Can the ERP bill travel time and per diems on remote jobs?

Yes. Timesheets record travel and standby as work types with a billable flag and rate multiplier, and expenses and per diems are re-billed to jobs through the expenses app.

Does the field app work where there is no cell coverage?

Yes. It stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs when a connection is available, with photo capture, on-screen signature and PDF preview offline.

Can it help us respond to three different refinery contractor portals?

It keeps each technician's certificates, vision tests, training and OJT hours and attachments in one structured record, so the evidence each refinery asks for can be pulled quickly. Direct integration with a client system is possible through the open REST API where the client allows it.

Does it warn when equipment is out of calibration?

Yes. Team assignments warn when assigned equipment is out of calibration, and the calibration certificate register sends expiry alerts.

Can we keep QuickBooks?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks and other systems that accept API connections, scoped during implementation.

How much does it cost?

Pricing is quote on request, based on your users, scope and integrations. The business apps are included rather than sold separately.

How do we start?

Send us your technician list, a recent refinery report and a recent remote-job invoice, and we will show you them in the system. Request a quote for Billings.
